messages:
Priya (CS): FYI Helix private deploy onboarding hit a snag during scale tests. Clients report 500s when fetching model artifacts; agent logs show envelope decryption errors and audit logs missing for some KMS calls.

Dev (NetEng): Can you paste a short log excerpt and confirm whether Helix is routing KMS via a VPC interface endpoint or NAT?

Priya (CS): Log snippet from agent: 
```
2026-02-02T09:12:04Z ERROR model_fetch: envelope_decrypt failed: KMSAccess: Unable to decrypt (KeyPolicy: Deny)
2026-02-02T09:12:04Z WARN request_id=xyz789 host=i-07abc route=/v1/models/load
```
No matching CloudTrail events for decrypt in the same minute; flow logs show SYN/ACK to an IP that resolves to the region but no TLS handshake in some flows.

Raj (Security): Two quick hypotheses: 1) The VPC endpoint policy for the KMS interface endpoint may block decrypt for cross-account keys; 2) If private DNS for the endpoint is disabled, SDKs might try to reach public KMS and be routed through a proxy/NAT with restrictive TLS termination that drops the handshake (hence missing CloudTrail).

Sam (Infra): Helix confirmed they created an interface endpoint but disabled private DNS because they wanted split-horizon routing. They also have a proxy appliance that performs SNI inspection. That combo can cause connections to go out via internet if hostname resolution returns public IPs for some instances.

HelixOps: We did notice the proxy returns RST for some large TLS sessions during ramp. We rolled out a new proxy rule yesterday.

Dev (NetEng): OK actionable checklist for Helix to run now:
```
# check if interface endpoint has private DNS
aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters "Name=service-name,Values=com.amazonaws.us-west-2.kms" --query 'VpcEndpoints[*].{id:VpcEndpointId,privateDns:PrivateDnsEnabled}' --output table
# validate endpoint policy
aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --vpc-endpoint-ids vpce-0123456789abcdef --query 'VpcEndpoints[0].PolicyDocument' --output json
# quick client test
openssl s_client -connect kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443 -servername kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
```

Priya (CS): I asked Helix to run these and to temporarily bypass the proxy for KMS hostnames. Noted renewal exposure if artifact access fails during their GA ramp.

HelixOps: We enabled private DNS for the endpoint and set a bypass for the proxy to allow direct egress to KMS. After that we saw decrypt success rates go from ~40%->99% during a 15m retest. Were also updating the endpoint policy to allow the role used by nodes to call Decrypt on the CMK in the sec-account.

Raj (Security): Good. Follow-ups before closing:
- Helix to paste final key policy and endpoint policy for our review.
- We should add an onboarding checklist item: "If using interface endpoints, enable private DNS or verify DNS routing to ensure KMS traffic does not traverse inspection proxies."
- Add a KB short doc: "Avoiding KMS/Proxy surprises in Private Deploy".

Sam (Infra): Also recommend adding a post-onboard validation test we can automate: 1) verify KMS Decrypt via agent; 2) check for CloudTrail event presence within 30s; 3) validate TLS handshake capture.

Priya (CS): Ill draft the KB + checklist and schedule a 30m runbook walk for Helix tomorrow 11:00 PT. Marking account with a short-term renewal watch until post-onboard audit completes.

OpsBot: Runbook session created: 2026-02-03T11:00:00 PT - Helix onboarding validation.

Priya (CS): Thanks everyone. Will post the post-onboard summary and the KB link here once ready. :thumbsup:
